problems.title: A hypotenuse divided by its altitude
problems.question: In a right triangle sinθ=3/5. Find the hypotenuse divided by the altitude to it.
problems.idea: Recover cosθ, then use the area formula.

problems.title: Cancel a trigonometric expression
problems.question: Simplify (sinγ+cosγ)²−2/(tanγ+cotγ).
problems.idea: Rewrite tangent and cotangent using sine and cosine.
steps: It cancels the cross term, leaving 1 wherever the original expression is defined.

problems.title: Count integer solutions of a nested absolute value
problems.question: How many integers satisfy ||x|−2|≤3?
problems.idea: Remove the outer absolute value as a double inequality.
steps: The lower bound is automatic, so −5≤x≤5.

problems.title: A nested radical at x=199
problems.question: Evaluate $\frac{\sqrt{x+2\sqrt{x-3}-2}-1}{\sqrt{x-3}}$ at $x=199$.
problems.idea: The inner expression is a perfect square.

problems.title: Recover a side from three medians
problems.question: The medians AA₁,BB₁,CC₁ of ABC are 15,18,21. Find AC.
problems.idea: Use the inverse median-length formula.
steps: Taking the positive square root gives AC=8√7.

problems.title: A quadratic with a hidden domain
problems.question: Solve x²+(√(x+3))²−14=0.
problems.idea: The squared root simplifies, but its domain still matters.
steps: The negative-sign root is below −3 and is invalid.

problems.title: Integer roots and factor pairs
problems.question: How many integers b make both roots of x²+bx−12=0 integers?
problems.idea: Their product must be −12.
steps: The unordered pairs are (1,−12),(2,−6),(3,−4) and their sign reversals.
Their b values are 11,4,1,−11,−4,−1, all distinct.

problems.title: An angle bisector opposite the middle side
problems.question: A triangle side is half the second and two thirds of the third. The bisector to the middle-length side is 2√6. Find the perimeter.
problems.idea: Write the sides in ratio 2:3:4 and use the bisector-length formula.
formulas: For sides b,c adjacent to angle A, lₐ²=bc[1−a²/(b+c)²].
steps: Let sides be 2t,3t,4t; the bisector is opposite 3t.

problems.title: Cancel a quadratic rational expression
problems.question: Simplify (2−3b−2b²)/(6b²−5b+1).
problems.idea: Factor both numerator and denominator.
steps: Cancel 2b−1 and reverse the remaining denominator’s sign.

problems.title: Sum of squares of two absolute-value roots
problems.question: Find the sum of squares of the solutions of 2x²−3x²/|x|=0.
problems.idea: The denominator excludes zero and x²/|x|=|x|.

problems.title: A side adjacent to a 60-degree angle
problems.question: A triangle has circumradius 4, angle 60°, and one adjacent side 6. Find the other adjacent side.
problems.idea: Use the extended sine rule followed by the cosine rule.
formulas: Opposite side a=2R sin60°=4√3; a²=6²+x²−12x cos60°.
steps: The roots are 3±√21; only the positive one is a side length.

problems.title: Product of roots in an absolute-value equation
problems.question: Find the product of the solutions of |x²+6x+3|=|x²+4x+5|.
problems.idea: Equal absolute values mean equal or opposite arguments.

problems.title: Minimize the sum of squared roots
problems.question: For which real a is the sum of squared roots of x²+ax+2a−6=0 smallest?
problems.idea: Use Vieta’s formulas without solving the quadratic.
steps: The discriminant (a−4)²+8 is always positive, so both roots are real for all a.
The square is smallest at a=2.

problems.title: Integer third sides of an obtuse triangle
problems.question: Two sides of an obtuse triangle are 3 cm and 13 cm. Find the sum of all possible integer third-side lengths.
problems.idea: Combine the triangle inequality with the obtuse-angle criterion.
formulas: 10<c<16; largest side squared must exceed the sum of the other two squares.
steps: For c≤13, require 169>9+c²: c=11,12. For c>13, require c²>178: c=14,15.

problems.title: Add two binary numbers
problems.question: Add binary numbers 1101 and 11100, giving the result in binary.
problems.idea: Convert to decimal or carry in base two.
problems.note: The printed choices omit 101001, so the option saying none of the preceding answers is correct applies.

problems.title: Polynomial divisibility at two roots
problems.question: f(x)=2x³−x²+ax+b is divisible by x²−1. Find a²−b².
problems.idea: Both 1 and −1 must be roots.
steps: Adding gives 2b−2=0, so b=1. Then a=−2.

problems.title: An incenter divides a bisector
problems.question: In MNK, MN:NK:KM=5:4:3. In what ratio does the incenter divide the bisector from M?
problems.idea: Use the ratio of adjacent-side sum to opposite side.
formulas: If L is the bisector foot and I the incenter, MI:IL=(MN+MK):NK.
steps: Equivalently, measured from the side toward M, LI:IM=1:2.
problems.note: The printed ratio 1:2 uses the order from the bisector foot toward the vertex; the problem does not explicitly specify the order.

problems.title: Count real roots of a cubic
problems.question: How many real roots does x³−2x²+18x=0 have?
problems.idea: Factor out x and inspect the quadratic discriminant.
steps: The quadratic has no real roots.
The factor x gives the only real root x=0.

problems.title: Distance between diagonal midpoints
problems.question: In a convex quadrilateral, distances between midpoints of adjacent sides are 8 cm and 6 cm, and the angle between those midpoint segments is 60°. Find the distance between the original diagonal midpoints.
problems.idea: Use vectors in the midpoint parallelogram.
formulas: If adjacent midpoint-side vectors are u,v, then |u|=8, |v|=6 and the original diagonal-midpoint difference is u−v.
steps: The square of the required distance is |u−v|²=64+36−2·8·6 cos60°=52.

problems.title: Two quadratic equations in symmetric form
problems.question: Find x²+y² if x²−xy=6 and y²−xy=3.
problems.idea: Find squares of the sum and difference.
steps: Since x−y=±3, x+y=±1 with matching signs.

problems.title: One root is twice the other
problems.question: Find all a for which one root of x²−(a+2)x+2a=0 is twice the other.
problems.idea: Factor the quadratic first.

problems.title: A circumradius without the third side
problems.question: Two sides are 6 and 12, and the altitude to the third side is 4. Find the circumradius.
problems.idea: The third side cancels between the area and circumradius formulas.

problems.title: Two water additions with a removal between
problems.question: A vessel initially has 80% alcohol solution. Add 1 L water, remove 3 L mixture, then add 1 L water. The final concentration is 50%. Find the original volume.
problems.idea: Removing well-mixed solution preserves its current concentration.
formulas: Initial volume V; alcohol after removal=0.8V(V−2)/(V+1); final volume=V−1.
steps: V=1/3 is impossible because there would be less than 3 L to remove after the first addition.

problems.title: A changed purchase quantity and price
problems.question: A firm planned to spend 3000 lari on a reagent. It buys 200 kg more at 3 lari less per kg, spending 4800 lari. Find the actual price per kg.
problems.idea: Use price times quantity for both purchases.
steps: Thus n=200 kg. The actual price is 4800/400.

problems.title: Three chords from one circle point
problems.question: BA=1, BC=2, BD=6 are circle chords and angle ABD=DBC. Find the perimeter of cyclic quadrilateral ABCD.
problems.idea: The equal inscribed angles imply equal chords AD and DC.
formulas: Let AD=DC=s and θ=ABD=DBC. Cosine rule: (37−s²)/12=(40−s²)/24.
